mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.nickname, SUM(p.views) AS cumulative_views, COUNT(p.post_id) AS post_count FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m USING (member_id) GROUP BY m.member_id, m.nickname ORDER BY post_count DESC, SUM(p.views) DESC, m.member_id ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.post_id, c.category, p.title, p.content, m.nickname, p.views, p.created_at, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%M-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str FROM post p LEFT JOIN post_category c USING (category_id) LEFT JOIN member m USING (member_id)
ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p LEFT JOIN post_category c USING (category_id)

SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, c.category, p.title, p.content, m.nickname, p.views, p.created_at, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN post_category c USING (category_id) WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET views = views + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (member_id, category_id, title, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content})
